我的生活与家庭生活(My Life and family life): 一篇关于家庭生活的A2短文:马克斯与安娜的经历和小计划。
Max and Anna had great fun there. Max hopes to visit Sydney one day. The weather was sunny that day. What's more, a tall poplar sways outside my bedroom window.
Max thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. Life is full of small surprises. Max learned a lot about science. For example, the squire owned half the village land.
Max plays basketball with Anna every Tuesday. Max wants to be a doctor in the future. Max likes sunny days best. Also, grandmother told me a story last night.
The weekend breakfast is one of the best places in the city. They took many photos at the living room. There are always many people at the living room.
